identity.label: CampFire
identity.intro: CampFire keeps the conversations, stories, meals and ideas that make camp more than a place to hunt.

featured.title: MeatEater Radio Live
featured.subtitle: Conversation as a modern campfire.
featured.discussionPrompt: What conversation from hunting camp has stayed with you the longest?
overview: For this private DeerCamp Showcase, MeatEater Radio Live illustrates how a conversation can become part of a hunting camp's permanent story.
A camp conversation may begin as something shared in the moment. DeerCamp is designed to give camps a place to preserve the story, the people connected to it, and the conversations that follow.
whyItMatters: Some of the memories people value most from hunting camp are not photographs of the hunt. They are the conversations before daylight, around the table, and after everyone returns to camp.
CampFire gives those conversations a home alongside the photos, voices, traditions and other memories preserved throughout DeerCamp.
featured.sourceLabel: Publicly available MeatEater Radio Live reference
featured.actionCopy: Preserve a conversation, lesson or story your camp still talks about.

featured.title: The MeatEater Outdoor Cookbook
featured.subtitle: The meal is part of the hunting story.
featured.discussionPrompt: Which camp meal or recipe deserves to be passed down?
overview: For this private DeerCamp Showcase, The MeatEater Outdoor Cookbook illustrates how food can carry the story of a hunt beyond the field.
Recipes often become part of camp identity: who prepared the meal, where the game came from, which opening weekend it was served, and why everyone asks for it again the following year.
whyItMatters: A hunting camp's legacy is not limited to harvested animals or photographs. Meals, recipes and the people who prepare them can become traditions remembered across generations.
DeerCamp can preserve those recipes alongside the memories and voices that explain why they matter to the camp.
featured.sourceLabel: Publicly available The MeatEater Outdoor Cookbook reference
featured.actionTitle: What Recipe Would Your Camp Preserve?
featured.actionCopy: Save a camp recipe together with the memory, person or tradition behind it.

featured.title: Stories Shared
featured.subtitle: The best hunting stories often begin with people sitting down together.
featured.discussionPrompt: Who is the best storyteller in your camp?
overview: For this private DeerCamp Showcase, Stories Shared demonstrates a simple truth about hunting camp: the people telling the stories are often as important as the hunt itself.
A familiar story changes as different members remember the details, add their own perspective, or explain what happened before and after the moment captured in a photograph.
whyItMatters: When a camp preserves only photographs, much of the context can disappear as years pass. Names, voices, humor and small details are often what transform an image into a lasting memory.
DeerCamp connects those people and their stories so future members can understand not only what happened, but who was there and why the memory mattered.

featured.actionTitle: Who Tells the Stories in Your Camp?
featured.actionCopy: Capture the voice, memory or perspective of someone whose stories help define your camp.
